items.title: Keypoints
items.description: A titled panel listing the main points an article covers — one bullet per `KeypointsItem`. Usually sits right after the intro.
items.author: pmndrs
items.docs: Renders on stock shadcn tokens apart from `bg-surface-dim`, which is why it depends on `pmndrs/design-system/md3` — MD3 has a surface role shadcn has no equivalent for. Installing it without that dependency resolved leaves the panel with no background at all, and Tailwind reports nothing.
